# Normalize a grid-coordinate argument

```r
.normalize_grid_argument(value, n, default, name)
```

## Arguments

- `value`: Argument value, or `NULL`.
- `n`: Expected argument length.
- `default`: Default scalar value used when `value` is `NULL`.
- `name`: Argument name used in error messages.

## Returns

A vector of length `n`.

## Description

Normalize a grid-coordinate argument
